description: This file defines the PaymentMethod class, which models payment methods including their code, type, default status, associated module, and configuration info for use within the shop system.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Represents a payment method with metadata and configuration details for display and processing.

methods.name: getPaymentType
methods.description: Returns the type of the payment method.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the type of the payment method.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodCode
methods.description: Returns the unique code identifying the payment method.

methods.name: setPaymentMethodCode
methods.description: Sets the unique code for the payment method.

methods.name: isDefaultSelected
methods.description: Checks if this payment method is the default selected option.

methods.name: setDefaultSelected
methods.description: Marks this payment method as default or not.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the integration module associated with the payment method.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the integration module for the payment method.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration information associated with the payment method.

methods.name: setInformations
methods.description: Sets the configuration information for the payment method.
